data.name: Romil
data.gender_notes: Romil is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Romil is a Sanskrit and Hindi name for the Lord of the Gods. This powerful name is a combination of the words 'Rama' and 'Mila', meaning 'Lord of the Gods'. It is a name that embodies strength, wisdom, and courage, and is often given to babies as a sign of devotion and respect. The name Romil carries the meaning “Lord of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Romil usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Romil is a sacred name that symbolizes the divine presence within. It is a reminder of the power and wisdom of the gods, and encourages one to live a virtuous and godly life. It is believed to bring good fortune, happiness, and success to those who bear this name.
data.etymology: Romil belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Romil total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
